section_summary.extract_value: This section presents confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) results for the Romanian BAS-2 scale using a second subsample of 243 participants. The initial one-factor model showed poor fit indices, but after freeing error covariances between specific item pairs based on theoretical rationale, an acceptable fit was achieved (CFI = .950, RMSEA = .090). The final model demonstrated good internal consistency with Cronbach's alpha of .89.
section_summary.evidence_source: Section 3.2.1 'Hypothesized model fit' describing CFA analysis of BAS-2 factor structure.
